...A strong thunderstorm will impact portions of southwestern
Oklahoma County through 600 PM CST...

At 526 PM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over 
southwestern Oklahoma City, near Will Rogers International Airport, 
moving east-northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Half inch hail and accumulating hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Accumulating 
         hail may make roads slick.

Locations impacted include...
Oklahoma City, Del City, and Valley Brook.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
